text:
Mara: FYI i've opened a PR to align the evidence matrix doc with the new audit-export SDK snippets. Need quick eyes on wording + one run by legal. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/824
Jin: thanks — link looks good. are we changing any retention language in the matrix or just adding examples?
Mara: mostly examples + a small note on tenant vs customer data handling. also adding a pseudonymization example for the export CLI and python sdk.
Samir: can you paste the snippet here? easier to review inline.
Mara: sure — current proposed curl snippet:
```bash
# export audit evidence for tenant_id=acme-123 pseudonymize=true
curl -X POST \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"tenant_id\":\"acme-123\",\"pseudonymize\":true,\"range\":{\"from\":\"2025-01-01\",\"to\":\"2025-02-01\"}}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export
```
and python SDK example:
```py
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.export_evidence(tenant_id='acme-123', pseudonymize=True, from_ts='2025-01-01', to_ts='2025-02-01')
```
Mara: i added a short blurb about how pseudonymization affects evidentiary fields (we keep event timestamps, drop/display hashed user identifiers).
Jin: wording looks fine but legal should confirm if \"drop/display hashed user identifiers\" is acceptable phrasing for SOC2. pinging @legal-ops. :eyes:
legal-ops: quick read — prefer \"mask\" instead of \"drop/display hashed\". suggested phrasing: \"Identifiers are pseudonymized (hashed) in exported evidence; timestamps and audit metadata are retained.\"
Mara: ok will swap to that. also we need to add a note about retention defaults — current plan is to reference the retention table and call out that export respects tenant-level TTLs. want to make sure we don't accidentally say data \"deleted immediately\" anywhere.
Samir: from the API side exports respect TTLs; but export of historical evidence for legal-hold should be clarified as an exception. i can add an ops note to the PR explaining the behavior.
Jin: small nit — can we include the exact field names that are pseudonymized so SDK users can map them? e.g., `user_id`, `email`, `session_id`?
Mara: added a bullet list in the doc. also included an example of downstream schema mapping for customers who ingest the export.
devex-bot: Reminder: docs PR checklist — include CODEOWNERS, add a short snippet test, and update the changelog.
Mara: thanks — have added CODEOWNERS and a tiny unit test that validates the sample json structure.
legal-ops: one more suggestion: replace \"tenant\" with \"tenant (customer-owned namespace)\" in places where it might be ambiguous. SOC2 reviewers flagged the ambiguity previously.
Mara: good call. i'll make that swap across the matrix.
Jin: i'm happy to review final wording after changes. quick pass planned at 11:30 PT.
Samir: FYI i'll also attach a short ops runbook section explaining how to handle legal hold exports (permissions + encryption in transit).
Mara: perfect. i'll push an update in ~30m and drop a note in the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
